text:
maria: quick design review please — suppression settings for multi-channel alerts. wondering about copy for the per-channel mute and the inline preview. cc @ashok :eyes:
ashok: got it. are we focusing on the modal or the compact inline row in the alert rule list?
jordan: both? the compact row is the pain point — hard to scan which channels are suppressed. maybe stronger badges.
maria: good point. current idea: small pill per channel that shows state and hover reveals mute duration + reason. but worried about color contrast and keyboard access.
design-bot: prototype uploaded: https://figma.com/s/redwood/alerts-suppression-v3 (comment pin: compact-row, pills, preview)
sam: preview copy option — currently shows "Muted" vs "Notifications On". suggestion: change to "Notifications: off" / "Notifications: on" for consistent noun phrase.
olivia: prefer verb-first? "Mute: 3h" felt weird in tests. "Notifications: off (3h)" reads clearer to me.
ashok: accessibility nit — pills are 12px text on colored background. need WCAG AA contrast at 14px minimum. also ensure focus ring when tabbing through channels.
maria: agree, bump to 14px and stronger focus outline. also add aria-label on the pill: e.g., `aria-label=\"Channel: PagerDuty, notifications off for 3 hours\"`
jordan: small code example for screen readers:
```
<button aria-pressed="true" aria-label="Slack: notifications off for 2 hours">Slack • off</button>
```
kim: also think about wording for the confirmation toast when you mute a channel. current: "Channel muted". propose: "Notifications paused for Slack — 2 hours" so users know which channel and duration.
sam: +1. add an undo in the toast: "Notifications paused for Slack — 2 hours · Undo"
maria: UX flow question: when muting from the rule list, should preview update in-place or require opening the preview panel?
jordan: in-place update is nicer for rapid changes, but we need an animation to avoid flicker. maybe a 200ms crossfade.
olivia: copy tweak: in the preview header show phrase: "Who will be notified" -> change to "Notified channels & recipients" (more explicit).
ashok: accessibility: preview panel should have `role=dialog` and trap focus only when opened via keyboard. if it's inline expand, it should be `aria-expanded` on the toggle.
maria: decision checklist:
- pills: 14px, higher contrast, focus ring ✅
- pill aria-labels and button pattern ✅
- toast: include channel name, duration, undo ✅
- preview header copy -> "Notified channels & recipients" ✅
- in-place preview update with 200ms crossfade (safe for reduced-motion users) ✅
kim: FYI, I saw a semantic issue: we currently use "Suppress" in primary CTA and "Mute" elsewhere. can we standardize?
sam: prefer "Mute" (more user-friendly). replace instances of "Suppress" in UI copy.
maria: action items:
- @ashok update pill styles + aria code sample (owner)
- @jordan add animation and reduced-motion fallback in spec (owner)
- @kim sweep copy strings and replace "Suppress" -> "Mute" where applicable (owner)
- @olivia update preview header and toast copy (owner)
- @design-bot attach updated figma when done
ashok: I'll push a small CSS snippet in the thread tomorrow for the focus ring and contrast swatches.
design-bot: reminder: design review meeting scheduled Thu 10:30 to finalize wording and accessibility checks. :calendar:
maria: thanks all — will follow up with a final spec and copy table.
jordan: :thumbsup:
kim: thanks!
